submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.0242%) at Sb 0.31, from 5 measurements across the line. EQE falls toward the Sb-rich end (Sb 0.48: 0.0093%, Sb 0.65: 0.0140%) and is lower at Sb 0.17 (0.0216%) and Sb 0.26 (0.0170%). This points to a Pb-rich optimum near Sb 0.3, but Sb 0.36 to 0.44 was never measured, so a higher peak there cannot be ruled out.
